namespace QleisliKernel.SourceTypes.NaturalCatalog
open Semantics.SourceNatural
abbrev WorkM := Finite.WorkM

structure Key where
  moduleName : String
  declarationName : String
  deriving BEq, DecidableEq, Repr

structure Original where
  key : Key
  source : String
  declaration : Declaration
  helper : NaturalHeaders.Helper
  calls : List (Path × Key) := []

private def adapt {α : Type} (result : Except String α) : WorkM α :=
  Finite.lift (result.mapError fun _ => .request)

private def keyCells (key : Key) : Nat :=
  key.moduleName.utf8ByteSize+key.declarationName.utf8ByteSize+1

private def gather (sources : Sources) : WorkM (List Original) := do
  let (_,helpers) ← sources.toList.foldlM (fun (modules,helpers) (moduleName,source) => do
    Finite.exactWork (Exact.charge ((moduleName.utf8ByteSize+1)*(modules.length+1)+source.utf8ByteSize+1))
    Finite.guard (!modules.contains moduleName) .request
    let declarations ← adapt (SourceTypes.declarations source)
    let (_,helpers) ← declarations.foldlM (fun (names,helpers) declaration => do
      Finite.exactWork (Exact.charge ((declaration.name.utf8ByteSize+1)*(names.length+1)))
      Finite.guard (!names.contains declaration.name) .request
      if declaration.kind != "static-fn" then return (declaration.name :: names,helpers)
      let helper ← adapt (NaturalHeaders.read declaration)
      let original : Original := ⟨⟨moduleName,declaration.name⟩,source,declaration,helper,[]⟩
      return (declaration.name :: names,original :: helpers)) (([] : List String),helpers)
    return (moduleName :: modules,helpers)) (([] : List String),([] : List Original))
  return helpers.reverse

private def resolve (sources : Sources) (original : Original) (path : Path) : WorkM Key := do
  Finite.exactWork (Exact.charge ((path.map String.utf8ByteSize).sum+path.length+1))
  if let [name] := path then
    Finite.exactWork (Exact.charge ((name.utf8ByteSize+1)*(original.helper.parameters.length+1)))
    Finite.guard (!original.helper.parameters.contains name) .request
  let target ← resolveReference sources original.key.moduleName (List.intersperse "::" path)
  Finite.guard (target.declaration.kind == "static-fn") .request
  return ⟨target.moduleName,target.declaration.name⟩

private def scan : Nat → Sources → List Original → Original → List Expr →
    List (Path × Key) → WorkM (List (Path × Key)) :=
  Nat.rec (fun _ _ _ pending calls =>
      if pending.isEmpty then pure calls else throw .limit)
    (fun _ recurse sources catalog original pending calls => do
      Finite.exactWork (Exact.charge 1)
      match pending with
      | [] => return calls
      | expression :: rest =>
        match expression with
        | .number _ => recurse sources catalog original rest calls
        | .name path =>
          let [name] := path | throw .request
          Finite.exactWork (Exact.charge ((name.utf8ByteSize+1)*(original.helper.parameters.length+1)))
          Finite.guard (original.helper.parameters.contains name) .request
          recurse sources catalog original rest calls
        | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b =>
          Finite.exactWork (Exact.charge 2)
          recurse sources catalog original (a::b::rest) calls
        | .call path arguments =>
          let key ← resolve sources original path
          Finite.exactWork (Exact.charge ((catalog.length+1)*(keyCells key+1)+arguments.length+1))
          let [target] := catalog.filter (fun entry => entry.key == key) | throw .request
          Finite.guard (arguments.length == target.helper.parameters.length) .request
          Finite.exactWork (Exact.charge ((calls.length+1)*((path.map String.utf8ByteSize).sum+keyCells key+1)))
          let calls := if calls.contains (path,key) then calls else (path,key) :: calls
          recurse sources catalog original (arguments ++ rest) calls)

private def dependencies (sources : Sources) (catalog : List Original) (original : Original) :
    WorkM Original := do
  Finite.exactWork (Exact.charge (2*original.helper.premises.length+1))
  let pending := original.helper.body :: original.helper.premises.flatMap (fun p => [p.left,p.right])
  let calls ← scan (original.source.utf8ByteSize+1) sources catalog original pending []
  return {original with calls := calls.reverse}

private def order : Nat → List Original → List Original → WorkM (List Original) :=
  Nat.rec (fun pending ready => if pending.isEmpty then pure ready.reverse else throw .request)
    (fun _ recurse pending ready => do
      if pending.isEmpty then return ready.reverse
      Finite.exactWork (Exact.charge (pending.length+ready.length+1))
      let readyKeys := ready.map (·.key)
      let next ← pending.foldlM (fun selected entry => do
        if selected.isSome then return selected
        Finite.exactWork (Exact.charge ((entry.calls.map (fun call => keyCells call.2+1)).sum*(ready.length+1)+1))
        return if entry.calls.all (fun call => readyKeys.contains call.2) then some entry else none) none
      let some next := next | throw .request
      Finite.exactWork (Exact.charge ((keyCells next.key+1)*(pending.length+1))))
      recurse (pending.filter (fun entry => entry.key != next.key)) (next :: ready))

/-- Original-source collection and topological order, including unused bodies.
The caller must still normalize every returned definition before any use. -/
def prepare (sources : Sources) : WorkM (List Original) := do
  let catalog ← gather sources
  let catalog ← catalog.mapM (dependencies sources catalog)
  order catalog.length catalog []

end QleisliKernel.SourceTypes.NaturalCatalog

Names/calls must be supplied by bound original readers; these parameters do not

namespace QleisliKernel.SourceTypes.NaturalNormalize
open Semantics.SourceNatural Semantics.SourceAffine NaturalAffine NaturalPredicates

structure Result (names : Valuation → Names) (calls : Calls) (meaning : Valuation → Prop)
    (fuel : Nat) (expression : Expr) where
  form : Form
  correct : ∀ values,meaning values → ∃ n,
    evaluate fuel (names values) calls expression = some n ∧ form.evaluate values = (n : Int)

theorem Result.value {names calls meaning fuel expression}
    (result : Result names calls meaning fuel expression) (values : Valuation)
    (held : meaning values) : ∃ n,Value (names values) calls expression n ∧
      result.form.evaluate values = (n : Int) := by
  obtain ⟨n,computed,same⟩ := result.correct values held
  exact ⟨n,evaluate_value _ _ _ _ _ computed,same⟩

structure Arguments (names : Valuation → Names) (calls : Calls) (meaning : Valuation → Prop)
    (fuel : Nat) (arguments : List Expr) where
  forms : List Form
  correct : ∀ values,meaning values → ∃ numbers,
    List.Forall₂ (fun e n => evaluate fuel (names values) calls e = some n) arguments numbers ∧
    List.Forall₂ (fun form n => form.evaluate values = (n : Int)) forms numbers

structure Readers (names : Valuation → Names) (calls : Calls) (meaning : Valuation → Prop) where
  name : ∀ fuel path, WorkM (Result names calls meaning (fuel+1) (.name path))
  call : ∀ fuel path arguments, Arguments names calls meaning fuel arguments →
    WorkM (Result names calls meaning (fuel+1) (.call path arguments))

private def readArguments {names calls meaning fuel}
    (read : ∀ expression,WorkM (Result names calls meaning fuel expression)) :
    Nat → (arguments : List Expr) → WorkM (Arguments names calls meaning fuel arguments) :=
  Nat.rec (fun arguments => match arguments with
      | [] => pure ⟨[],fun _ _ => ⟨[],.nil,.nil⟩⟩
      | _ :: _ => throw .limit)
    (fun _ recurse arguments => do
      Finite.exactWork (Exact.charge 1)
      match arguments with
      | [] => return ⟨[],fun _ _ => ⟨[],.nil,.nil⟩⟩
      | first :: rest =>
        let head ← read first
        let tail ← recurse rest
        return ⟨head.form :: tail.forms,by
          intro values held
          obtain ⟨n,computed,same⟩ := head.correct values held
          obtain ⟨numbers,computedTail,sameTail⟩ := tail.correct values held
          exact ⟨n :: numbers,.cons computed computedTail,.cons same sameTail⟩⟩)

private def step {names calls meaning} (fuel variables : Nat) (context : Context meaning)
    (readers : Readers names calls meaning)
    (recurse : ∀ expression,WorkM (Result names calls meaning fuel expression))
    (expression : Expr) : WorkM (Result names calls meaning (fuel+1) expression) := do
  Finite.exactWork (Exact.charge 1)
  match expression with
  | .number n =>
    let result ← witness (constant variables n)
    return ⟨result.val,by
      intro values _held
      refine ⟨n,rfl,?_⟩
      obtain ⟨work,left,ok⟩ := result.property
      exact constant_meaning _ _ _ _ _ ok values⟩
  | .name path => readers.name fuel path
  | .call path arguments => do
    Finite.exactWork (Exact.charge (arguments.length+1))
    let args ← readArguments recurse (arguments.length+1) arguments
    readers.call fuel path arguments args
  | .add a b =>
    let first ← recurse a
    let second ← recurse b
    let result ← witness (add first.form second.form)
    return ⟨result.val,by
      intro values held
      obtain ⟨x,hx,px⟩ := first.correct values held
      obtain ⟨y,hy,py⟩ := second.correct values held
      refine ⟨x+y,?_,?_⟩
      · change (do return (← evaluate fuel (names values) calls a) +
          (← evaluate fuel (names values) calls b)) = some (x+y)
        simp only [hx,hy,Option.pure_def]
      · obtain ⟨work,left,ok⟩ := result.property
        rw [add_meaning _ _ _ _ _ ok,px,py]
        rfl⟩
  | .sub a b =>
    let first ← recurse a
    let second ← recurse b
    let nonnegative ← provesLe context second.form first.form
    let result ← witness (sub first.form second.form)
    return ⟨result.val,by
      intro values held
      obtain ⟨x,hx,px⟩ := first.correct values held
      obtain ⟨y,hy,py⟩ := second.correct values held
      have le : y ≤ x := by
        have bounded := nonnegative.proof values held
        rw [px,py] at bounded

      refine ⟨x-y,?_,?_⟩
      · change (do
          let x ← evaluate fuel (names values) calls a
          let y ← evaluate fuel (names values) calls b
          if y ≤ x then some (x-y) else none) = some (x-y)
        simp only [hx,hy,le,if_true]
      · obtain ⟨work,left,ok⟩ := result.property
        rw [sub_meaning _ _ _ _ _ ok,px,py]
        omega⟩

    let first ← recurse a
    let second ← recurse b
    let result ← witness (multiply first.form second.form)
    return ⟨result.val,by
      intro values held
      obtain ⟨x,hx,px⟩ := first.correct values held
      obtain ⟨y,hy,py⟩ := second.correct values held
      refine ⟨x*y,?_,?_⟩
      · change (do return (← evaluate fuel (names values) calls a) *
          (← evaluate fuel (names values) calls b)) = some (x*y)
        simp only [hx,hy,Option.pure_def]
      · obtain ⟨work,left,ok⟩ := result.property
        rw [multiply_meaning _ _ _ _ _ ok,px,py]
        rfl⟩

/-- Every successful arithmetic step is tied to the independent evaluator and
Value relation. Generic original-reader obligations are deliberately explicit. -/
def normalize {names calls meaning} (variables : Nat) (context : Context meaning)
    (readers : Readers names calls meaning) :
    (fuel : Nat) → (expression : Expr) → WorkM (Result names calls meaning fuel expression) :=
  Nat.rec (fun _ => throw .limit) (fun fuel recurse => step fuel variables context readers recurse)

end QleisliKernel.SourceTypes.NaturalNormalize

/-! Original formal identities in canonical affine order. Original ordinals
retain positional calls; sorting matches BinderKey's name-first iteration without

Copyright 2026 Qleisli Project Contributors. SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 -/
namespace QleisliKernel.SourceTypes.NaturalFrames
open Semantics.SourceNatural Semantics.SourceAffine NaturalAffine NaturalPredicates

structure Binder where
  owner : NaturalCatalog.Key
  ordinal : Nat
  name : String
  deriving BEq, DecidableEq, Repr

structure Frame where
  binders : List Binder

def original (helper : NaturalCatalog.Original) : Frame :=
  let binders := helper.helper.parameters.zipIdx.map fun (name,ordinal) =>
    (⟨helper.key,ordinal,name⟩ : Binder)
  ⟨binders.mergeSort (fun a b => a.name ≤ b.name)⟩

def lookup (frame : Frame) (path : Path) : Option Nat := do
  let [name] := path | none
  let (_,position) ← frame.binders.zipIdx.find? (fun (binder,_) => binder.name == name)
  return position

def names (frame : Frame) (values : Valuation) (path : Path) : Option Nat :=
  (lookup frame path).map (fun position => (values position).toNat)

def Natural (frame : Frame) (values : Valuation) : Prop :=
  ∀ position,position < frame.binders.length → 0 ≤ values position

def initial (frame : Frame) : WorkM (Context (Natural frame)) := do
  Finite.guard (frame.binders.length ≤ 32) .limit
  Finite.exactWork (Exact.charge (frame.binders.length*(frame.binders.length+3)+1))
  let rows := (List.range frame.binders.length).map (fun position =>
    (coordinate frame.binders.length position).scale (-1))
  let _ ← rows.mapM valid
  return ⟨[rows],by
    intro values
    rw [satisfies_singleton]
    constructor
    · intro held position bound
      have member : (coordinate frame.binders.length position).scale (-1) ∈ rows :=
        List.mem_map.mpr ⟨position,List.mem_range.mpr bound,rfl⟩
      have negative := held _ member
      rw [Form.evaluate_scale,coordinate_evaluate] at negative
      omega
    · intro held row member
      obtain ⟨position,bound,same⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
      subst row
      rw [Form.evaluate_scale,coordinate_evaluate]
      have nonnegative := held position (List.mem_range.mp bound)
      omega⟩

def readName {meaning : Valuation → Prop} (frame : Frame) (calls : Calls)
    (natural : ∀ values,meaning values → Natural frame values) (fuel : Nat) (path : Path) :
    WorkM (NaturalNormalize.Result (names frame) calls meaning (fuel+1) (.name path)) := do
  Finite.exactWork (Exact.charge ((path.map String.utf8ByteSize).sum+
    (frame.binders.map (fun b => b.name.utf8ByteSize+1)).sum+1))
  let some position := found : lookup frame path | throw .request
  if bound : position < frame.binders.length then
    let result ← witness (parameter frame.binders.length position)
    return ⟨result.val,by
      intro values held
      refine ⟨(values position).toNat,?_,?_⟩
      · change names frame values path = some (values position).toNat
        simp only [names,found,Option.map_some]
      · obtain ⟨work,left,ok⟩ := result.property
        rw [parameter_meaning _ _ _ _ _ ok]
        exact (Int.toNat_of_nonneg (natural values held position bound)).symm⟩
  else throw .request

def replacementValues (replacements : List Form) (values : Valuation) : Valuation :=

private theorem replacement_head (head : Form) (tail : List Form) (values : Valuation) :
    replacementValues (head::tail) values 0 = head.evaluate values := rfl

private theorem replacement_tail (head : Form) (tail : List Form) (values : Valuation) :
    (fun i => replacementValues (head::tail) values (i+1)) = replacementValues tail values := rfl

structure Result (template : Form) (replacements : List Form) where
  form : Form
  correct : ∀ values,form.evaluate values = template.evaluate (replacementValues replacements values)

private structure Accumulated (coefficients : List Int) (replacements : List Form) (prior : Form) where
  form : Form
  correct : ∀ values,form.evaluate values = prior.evaluate values +
    dot coefficients (replacementValues replacements values)

private def loop : Nat → (coefficients : List Int) → (replacements : List Form) → (prior : Form) →
    WorkM (Accumulated coefficients replacements prior) :=
  Nat.rec (fun _ _ _ => throw .limit) (fun _ recurse coefficients replacements prior => do
    Finite.exactWork (Exact.charge 1)
    match coefficients,replacements with
    | [],[] => return ⟨prior,by intro values; simp only [dot_nil,Int.add_zero]⟩
    | coefficient :: rest,head :: tail =>

        return ⟨result.form,by
          intro values
          rw [result.correct,dot_cons,zero,Int.zero_mul,Int.zero_add,replacement_tail]⟩
      else

        let next ← witness (add prior scaled.val)
        let result ← recurse rest tail next.val
        return ⟨result.form,by
          intro values
          obtain ⟨scaleWork,scaleLeft,scaleOk⟩ := scaled.property
          obtain ⟨addWork,addLeft,addOk⟩ := next.property
          rw [result.correct,add_meaning _ _ _ _ _ addOk,
            scale_meaning _ _ _ _ _ scaleOk,dot_cons,replacement_head,replacement_tail]
          omega⟩
    | _,_ => throw .request)

def check (original : NaturalCatalog.Original) (calls : Calls)
    (callReader : CallsReader (NaturalFrames.original original) calls) :
    WorkM (Prepared original calls) := do
  let frame := NaturalFrames.original original
